description: Primary TED API search-field name, with source spelling and case preserved.
derivation: Copied without alias expansion or case normalization; repeated when the source references several SDK fields. Not unique alone.
key_role: row grain: search field plus parsed SDK reference; uniqueness is not enforced by the builder

description: Normalized individual SDK reference used for the left join.
source: semantic base/API/List_of_search_fields.csv#Reference in the eForms SDK; semantic base/field semantics/CSVs download/fields.csv#fieldId
derivation: Trim and lowercase source reference and fieldId keys; split comma/semicolon/newline only outside brackets; explode references; remove bracketed conditions. Blank reference rows are retained; a nonblank key may still be unmatched.
key_role: row grain: search field plus parsed SDK reference; uniqueness is not enforced by the builder

description: Business-term identifier recorded on the matched SDK implementing field.
derivation: Copied after a many-to-one validated join on sdk_field_key; not derived from an API field name or ID prefix. Blank when source metadata or the SDK match is missing.

description: SDK implementing-field type, such as code, indicator or text-multilingual.
derivation: Copied from the matched source. Describes the SDK field, not the API request parameter or response JSON shape. Blank for missing source metadata or an unmatched key.
Source text copied from the matched SDK field; distinct from the API search-field name and its displayed nameLabel. Blank for missing source metadata or an unmatched key.

description: English human-readable field label in the local SDK CSV snapshot.
derivation: Copy the source label text, not a generated translation or unresolved localization key. Blank for missing source metadata or an unmatched key.

description: English human-readable SDK field description in the local source snapshot.
derivation: Copy the source description text. It is not proof that every API alias or response projection has identical representation or constraints. Blank for missing source metadata or an unmatched key.

description: Maximum length recorded for the SDK implementing field where applicable.
derivation: Pandas default NA parsing converts source NULL markers to missing values. Nonmissing integer-valued lengths are serialized with a decimal suffix (for example 1000.0) after the nullable numeric join; missing values export as empty cells. This is not an API query/filter length limit.

description: SDK business entity owning the matched implementing field, such as Lot or Organisation.
derivation: Copied from the matched SDK row; not inferred solely from suffixes in the API field name. Blank for missing source metadata or an unmatched key.
